items.title: Houthi attack damages Riyadh wealth fund tower
items.desc: Shafaq News- Riyadh A Houthi attack damaged several floors of a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District, as well as nearby buildings, without causing any injuries, according to Saudi Arabia's Civil Defense.
